reference_use.conclusion: The snapshot (project d8d46c95, Mathlib 25730c7c) holds the frozen Ch06 Contract. Child types therefore use only contract, SimonGMT and Mathlib names; all six new types elaborate in the exact comparator scope. Three accepted declarations of the slice-mass-bound branch have exactly the types the smooth Leibniz identity needs (slicing_mb_lb_extDeriv_smul, slicing_mb_lb_smul_testForm, slicing_mb_lb_wedge_testForm), so they are reused with byte-identical types. The C¹-chart cover and the C¹-chart tangent identification exist only as speculative-ready lpf nodes, so they are not reused; tangential_weak_limit proves them inside its natural proof. The chart change of variables and the directional-derivative lemmas are accepted (lpf_raf_chart_change_of_variables, lpf_ccr_hasDerivAt_line_of_comp) and are cited. Mathlib supplies Rademacher, integration by parts for Lipschitz functions, density of C_c^∞ in L¹, a smooth Urysohn function, Tannery's theorem, convolution smoothness, normalized bumps and Besicovitch differentiation. SimonGMT supplies the injective Lipschitz area formula and the uniqueness of weighted tangent planes. Neither library has a weak-convergence lemma for tangential gradients on rectifiable sets. Accepted candidates show that extra imports in Submission.lean pass the comparator. subproblem.title: The L¹ tangent vector field Y dual to θ·ξ⌞ω on a rectifiable triple
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P, (M, θ, ξ) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, and ω ∈ D^m(U). Then there is Y : ℝ^P → ℝ^P such that (a) Y is Hⁿ⌞M-integrable; (b) for every x ∈ ℝ^P and every continuous linear functional φ on ℝ^P, φ(Y(x)) = θ(x)·ξ(x)(alternatizeUncurryFin(φ.smulRight(ω(x)))) (i.e. φ(Y(x)) = θ(x)⟨φ∧ω(x), ξ(x)⟩); (c) for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M, Y(x) ∈ Q for every subspace Q which is a weighted approximate tangent plane of (M, θ) at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, ∃ Y : Eucl P → Eucl P, Integrable Y ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) ∧ (∀ (x : Eucl P) (φ : Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ), φ (Y x) = θ x * ξ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x)))) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x Q → Y x ∈ Q
subproblem.natural_proof:
Conventions. ℝ^P = Eucl P, ℝⁿ = Eucl n; Hᵏ := μHE[k] (Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure, equal to Lebesgue measure Lᵏ = volume on ℝᵏ); |·| is the Euclidean norm and ⟨·,·⟩ the inner product; Df(x) := fderiv ℝ f x (the Fréchet derivative where it exists and 0 otherwise). Source: parent proof, Steps 1–2 (the field Y with ⟨Y, w⟩ = θξ(w♭∧ω), its integrability and tangency). n := m + 1. For w ∈ ℝ^P let w♭ := innerSL ℝ w, so w♭(y) = ⟨w, y⟩ and ‖w♭‖ = |w| (`innerSL_apply_norm`). For a continuous linear functional φ on ℝ^P and α ∈ Λ^m := Covector (Eucl P) m put φ∧α := alternatizeUncurryFin(φ.smulRight α) ∈ Λ^{m+1}. By `ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply`, (φ∧α)(v_0, …, v_m) = Σ_{i=0}^{m} (−1)^i φ(v_i)·α(v_0, …, v̂_i, …, v_m) (v_i omitted, Fin.removeNth). The map (φ, α) ↦ φ∧α is bilinear (alternatizeUncurryFin is the linear map alternatizeUncurryFinCLM and φ.smulRight α is bilinear in (φ, α)) and ‖φ∧α‖ ≤ (m + 1)‖φ‖‖α‖ (`norm_alternatizeUncurryFin_le`, `norm_smulRight_apply`). Write ω also for the underlying form; K₀ := tsupport ω is compact with K₀ ⊆ U because ω ∈ D^m(U), and C_ω := sup_x ‖ω(x)‖ < ∞ because ω is continuous with compact support.
1. (Definition of Y.) Fix x ∈ ℝ^P. The map ℓ_x : ℝ^P → ℝ, ℓ_x(w) := θ(x)·ξ(x)(w♭∧ω(x)), is ℝ-linear (w ↦ w♭ is linear over ℝ, ∧ is bilinear, ξ(x) is linear), hence continuous (finite dimension). Let Y(x) be its Riesz representative, Y(x) := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (Eucl P)).symm ℓ_x, so that ⟨Y(x), w⟩ = ℓ_x(w) for all w (`InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply` and symmetry of the real inner product) and |Y(x)| = ‖ℓ_x‖. Equivalently Y(x) = Σ_{i<P} ℓ_x(e_i)e_i with e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1.
2. (Property (b).) Let x ∈ ℝ^P and φ ∈ (ℝ^P)*. With a := (toDual)⁻¹φ we have a♭ = φ (both send y to ⟨a, y⟩ = φ(y)). Hence φ(Y(x)) = ⟨a, Y(x)⟩ = ⟨Y(x), a⟩ = ℓ_x(a) = θ(x)ξ(x)(a♭∧ω(x)) = θ(x)ξ(x)(φ∧ω(x)) = θ(x)·ξ(x)(alternatizeUncurryFin(φ.smulRight(ω(x)))). This holds for every x and every φ.
3. (Vanishing off K₀.) If x ∉ K₀ then ω(x) = 0, so w♭∧ω(x) = 0 for all w, ℓ_x = 0 and Y(x) = 0. Thus Y = 1_{K₀}Y.
4. (Unit bound.) By the orientation clause of IsRectifiableTriple there is an Hⁿ⌞M-null set Z such that for every x ∉ Z there are an orthonormal τ : Fin n → ℝ^P and ε ∈ {1, −1} with ξ(x) = ε·simpleNVector τ, where simpleNVector τ (β) = β(τ_0, …, τ_m) (`simpleNVector_apply`). For such x and every β ∈ Λ^{m+1}, |ξ(x)(β)| = |β(τ)| ≤ ‖β‖·∏_i|τ_i| = ‖β‖ (`ContinuousAlternatingMap.le_opNorm`). Consequently, for x ∉ Z and all w, |ℓ_x(w)| ≤ |θ(x)|·‖w♭∧ω(x)‖ ≤ (m + 1)|θ(x)||w|‖ω(x)‖, hence |Y(x)| = ‖ℓ_x‖ ≤ (m + 1)C_ω|θ(x)|·1_{K₀}(x) (using step 3).
5. (Measurability.) θ is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K₀ (field integrableOn of IsRectifiableTriple with the compact set K₀ ⊆ U), so θ is Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ K₀)-a.e. strongly measurable; ξ is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable (field aestronglyMeasurable), hence also Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ K₀)-a.e. strongly measurable; and for each i < P the map x ↦ β_i(x) := e_i♭∧ω(x) is continuous. Evaluation (L, β) ↦ L(β) from NVector × Covector to ℝ is continuous, so the coordinates Y_i(x) = ℓ_x(e_i) = θ(x)·ξ(x)(β_i(x)) are Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ K₀)-a.e. strongly measurable, and so is Y = Σ_i Y_i e_i. Since K₀ is closed (Borel), (Hⁿ⌞M)⌞K₀ = Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ K₀) and Y = 1_{K₀}Y, the function Y is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable (`aestronglyMeasurable_indicator_iff`).
6. (Property (a).) By step 4, |Y| ≤ (m + 1)C_ω|θ|1_{K₀} Hⁿ⌞M-a.e., and ∫_M |θ|1_{K₀} dHⁿ = ∫_{M∩K₀}|θ| dHⁿ < ∞. Together with step 5, Y is Hⁿ⌞M-integrable.
7. (Property (c).) M is Hⁿ-null-measurable, so Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x lies in M (`ae_restrict_mem₀`). Let x ∈ M ∖ Z, with τ, ε as in step 4, and W := span{τ_0, …, τ_m}, which by the orientation clause is a weighted approximate tangent plane of (M, θ) at x. Let Q be any weighted approximate tangent plane of (M, θ) at x. Since x ∈ M, θ(x) > 0, and uniqueness of weighted approximate tangent planes at points with θ(x) ≠ 0 (SimonGMT `HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique`) gives Q = W. Let w ∈ W^⊥. Then ⟨w, τ_i⟩ = 0 for all i, so (w♭∧ω(x))(τ_0, …, τ_m) = Σ_i (−1)^i⟨w, τ_i⟩·ω(x)(τ_0, …, τ̂_i, …, τ_m) = 0 and ⟨Y(x), w⟩ = ℓ_x(w) = θ(x)·ε·(w♭∧ω(x))(τ) = 0. Hence Y(x) ∈ (W^⊥)^⊥ = W = Q (`Submodule.orthogonal_orthogonal`; W is finite-dimensional). This holds for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x and every such Q. ∎
(The exact frozen type has been proved in Lean 4 / Mathlib 25730c7c in the comparator scope along these lines, with Y defined by the coordinate formula Y(x) = Σ_i θ(x)ξ(x)(e_i♭∧ω(x))e_i; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.)
proof_key_steps: Y(x) := Riesz representative of w ↦ θ(x)ξ(x)(w♭∧ω(x)); then φ(Y(x)) = θ(x)ξ(x)(φ∧ω(x)) for all x, φ.
Y = 0 off K₀ = tsupport ω; a.e. ξ(x) = ±simple(τ) with τ orthonormal, so |ξ(x)(β)| ≤ ‖β‖ and |Y| ≤ (m+1)C_ω|θ|1_{K₀}.
θ ∈ L¹(Hⁿ⌞(M∩K₀)), ξ a.e. strongly measurable, ω continuous ⇒ Y ∈ L¹(Hⁿ⌞M).
For w ⊥ span τ: (w♭∧ω(x))(τ) = Σ(−1)^i⟨w,τ_i⟩ω(x)(…) = 0, so Y(x) ∈ span τ = the unique weighted tangent plane.

audit.reason: The Riesz construction gives the global functional identity. Compact-support localization supplies measurability and integrability despite θ having only local integrability. The orientation clause, positivity and weighted-tangent uniqueness prove membership in every claimed tangent plane.
